column1: # Cases driven through the real PreToolUse hook by check-view-publish-refused.sh.
# Tab-separated. Blank lines and lines beginning with # are skipped.
#   id          names the case in the output
#   expect      deny     the gate emitted a deny decision
#               allow    the gate emitted an allow decision
#               blocked  the gate could not run at all and exited 2, which
#                        blocks the tool call with stderr as the reason
#   surface     page     the capability is asked for INSIDE the page
#               call     the capability is granted by the PUBLISH CALL - the
#                        surface check-view-readonly.sh states it cannot see
#               shape    a publish this gate cannot read at all
#               action   an Artifact action other than publish
#               output   a publish that must go through
#   page        a filename under pages/, or - for no file_path at all, or
#               raw:<text> to send <text> as the entire payload verbatim
#   caps        the publish call's capabilities argument as JSON, or -
#   action      the tool_input.action, or - to leave it absent

column7: note
